note: Engineering prompts, not automatic findings. Unknown capabilities need evidence. Mitigations require system-specific design.

domains.title: Task success and scope
questions: How is actual task completion verified?
Which tasks are ambiguous or forbidden?
When must execution clarify, stop or escalate?

domains.title: Planning, context and termination
questions: What prerequisites hold before actions?
What if context truncation loses constraints?
What bounds steps, progress and elapsed time?

domains.title: Retrieval integrity
questions: How are provenance and freshness checked?
How are missing or conflicting sources handled?
How do deletion and permissions propagate to indexes/caches?

domains.title: Prompt injection and goal hijacking
questions: Which inputs influence planning?
Can untrusted content change goals or destinations?
What constrains actions if detection fails?

domains.title: Identity and tenant isolation
questions: Which identity/authority governs execution?
Where are resource and tenant permissions checked?
What happens on revocation or policy-service failure?

domains.title: Tool contracts
questions: Are arguments semantically validated?
Can paths, queries or destinations escape constraints?
Are partial results distinct from success?

domains.title: Code execution containment
questions: What filesystem/process/network authority exists?
What enforces resource limits and isolation?
Can output become unsafe executable input downstream?

domains.title: Guardrails and approval integrity
questions: Where are controls enforced?
Can fallback/resume bypass them?
What happens when checks fail or overblock?
Is approval bound to exact action parameters and expiry?

domains.title: Retries and ambiguous outcomes
questions: Can a timed-out action have committed?
What are idempotency scope and key lifetime?
Are retries bounded across layers?

domains.title: Partial completion and concurrent state
questions: Where is execution state checkpointed?
How are stale/concurrent writes detected?
What if compensation fails or actions are irreversible?
How are restart/cancellation and in-flight actions reconciled?

domains.title: Capacity and cascading failure
questions: What bounds queues, concurrency, fan-out and latency?
How are slow dependencies isolated?
Does cancellation stop resource use?
How is overload handled without unsafe fallback?

domains.title: Cost exhaustion
questions: What bounds token/tool use and spend?
Can requests trigger recursive expensive work?
What happens when the budget expires?

domains.title: Persistent memory contamination
questions: Who writes memory and with what provenance?
How are tenants isolated and memory expired/deleted?
How is poisoned context recovered?

domains.title: Sensitive data movement
questions: What reaches context, services and logs?
Are destinations constrained and credentials protected?
How are retention/deletion/export rules enforced?

domains.title: Supply chain and capability changes
questions: Are tool origins/descriptions/dependencies reviewed?
Can an update silently expand capability?
Can affected connectors be isolated/reverted?

domains.title: MCP identity and connectors
questions: Are token audience, scope and delegation verified?
Are connector origins/outbound URLs constrained?
Is metadata treated as untrusted?

domains.title: Delegation and propagation
questions: Can delegation expand authority or recurse?
Are messages authenticated and scoped?
Can failure contaminate other agents/shared state?

domains.title: Evaluation and rollout
questions: Do tests inspect outcomes, forbidden actions and state?
Are repeated trials and graders validated?
Are model/prompt/tool/policy versions identifiable?
Can releases be contained/reverted without replaying writes?

domains.title: Observability and recovery
questions: Can execution be traced without exposing secrets?
Are incorrect outcomes detected alongside service errors?
Can tool execution be independently disabled?
Who owns reconciliation and are recovery procedures exercised?
